projection.algorithm_claim: angular/radial ellipsoid parameterization with full local-basis reconstruction; not Euclidean nearest-point projection

ellipsoid.sampling_policy: joint empirical case bootstrap; no independent Gaussian axis sampling in the final population generator

novelty.interpretation: Bootstrap-derived synthetic anatomies are derivatives, not independent patients. Distances quantify non-identity without claiming external generalization.

strategies.evaluation_level: full dense generator with rejection sampling
fixed-representation reconstruction plus dense B-spline and full validator
fixed-representation reconstruction plus dense B-spline and full validator

holdout.validation_type: internal source-grouped 5-fold fixed-representation holdout; not external validation
holdout.limitation: This tests internal representation stability and leakage control. It is not an external clinical cohort and does not remove selection bias in the 52 eligible cases.
